scope: Experimental authoritative cross-service external work ledger with JDBC persistence, receipt ownership, late reconciliation and complete versioned paging

verification.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

architecture.beforeDispatch: Synchronous authoritative work_register and work_start acknowledgement before actual backend start
architecture.afterTermination: Node retains callbacks and observed evidence; bounded asynchronous metadata publication
architecture.checkpoint: Pure work rows, cancellation deadlines, owner grant map, revision and sticky fault; no native execution replay
architecture.handoff: Settled local history retained with original IDs/evidence; active or unknown work denied
architecture.paging: 128 rows/page, revision and full summary validated; concurrent mutation fails explicitly; no silent truncation
architecture.diagnosticConcurrency: Remote snapshot does not hold task lock; blocked query cannot block heartbeat or revoke

normalCancel.topology: Two independent SDK JVMs, authenticated loopback HTTP status service, JDBC authority; fixed trusted Java child process
assertions: Owner cancellation waits for actual PID exit and direct-process receipt
Sibling session remains active after confirmed cancellation
Source view reads same global state

sdkKilled.clock: Real authority clock, observing actual lease expiration and confirmation timeout
sdkKilled.failure: Forcibly kill SDK JVM while its Java child remains alive
assertions: External PID still alive after SDK death
Lease expiration gives CANCEL_REQUESTED rather than confirmation
No receipt leads UNKNOWN with active=1 and allTerminationConfirmed=false
Sibling START denied before creating a new PID marker
sdkKilled.cleanup: Test host manually kills its owned child in finally; this is not claimed as SDK acknowledgement

lateReceipt.failure: HTTP endpoint captures and rejects work_finish to simulate lost terminal evidence
lateReceipt.clock: Mutable authority clock advances beyond original delegation expiry and cancellation deadline; physical PID exit is separately observed
assertions: Authenticated host replays captured genuine receipt against original private binding
Receipt accepted after expiry; active=0 and complete confirmation restored
Root fault remains external_execution_unconfirmed; execution is not revived

protocolAndStorage.globalConcurrency: ExternalWorkRegistryTest.independentRegistryInstancesCannotMultiplyGlobalActiveWorkLimit: 140 concurrent attempts, 128 accepted; prepared cancellation safely releases slots
protocolAndStorage.ownerChecks: Wrong grant or session cannot finish another execution; finished history cannot be dispatched again
protocolAndStorage.reopen: Fresh JDBC registry instances retain unknown/late-confirmed state and imported source history
protocolAndStorage.paging: ExternalWorkProtocolTest reads all 257 rows over HTTP without duplicate/truncated IDs
protocolAndStorage.schema: Reject coercion, unexpected fields, numeric evidence and string booleans
protocolAndStorage.state: ExternalExecutionStateTest covers pure restore, timeout, sticky late proof, ownership, invalid checkpoints and mixed snapshot rejection

privacy: Execution metadata contains opaque identifiers, kind, state, deadlines and proof plus authentication; captured work RPCs exclude executable paths, native fixture class, marker path, PID and model/query bodies; private transport fields remain sensitive
limitations: Trusted authenticated SDK host/backend evidence required; no independent remote kernel attestation
Only H2 and current-platform direct Java processes tested; production IAM/mTLS, HA/failover and whole-process-tree guarantees not claimed
No persistent node receipt outbox; lost final proof can remain unknown until trusted reconciliation
Whole-root JDBC checkpoints and large/high-throughput deployments require capacity verification
No automatic receipts for every model Provider HTTP operation; no billing refund or side-effect rollback implied
InMemory registry remains volatile; JDBC must be explicitly configured for restart persistence
Production identity, logical document versions, platform validation and P1 plan remain active
followUp: Guarded native MODEL_REQUEST lifecycle and optional trusted stop contract added; see model-termination-governance.json. Counts above remain this earlier phase verification.
